stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in generative AI tasks.
The model is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance to major AI frameworks like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: SpaceX declares Starship ready for orbit, sets launch date next week
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: SpaceX has announced that its Starship vehicle is ready for orbital flight.
The company has scheduled the next launch attempt for the upcoming week.
Achieving orbit represents a major technological milestone for the Starship program.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B parameter open model, is now accessible via Ollama.
The model is specifically designed for autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step tasks and tool calling.
It is optimized to run locally on user hardware, emphasizing on-device AI capabilities.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent tasks show up to 90% faster performance according to the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new large language model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM execution.

stories.title: A brief history of AI executives calling for regulation
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: High-profile AI industry leaders, including Sam Altman and Satya Nadella, are publicly advocating for AI regulation.
The consensus among these executives is a call to 'slow down' development to prevent loss of control.
This signals a significant shift in industry sentiment, moving from pure acceleration to acknowledging governance risks.

stories.title: Agility’s new humanoid robot will stop, squat to avoid harming human coworkers
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Agility is developing a new humanoid robot designed for collaborative human environments.
The robot incorporates advanced safety features, such as stopping or squatting to avoid injuring coworkers.
This development signals a move toward deploying robots outside of traditional, caged industrial settings.

stories.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
stories.author: Ling Yang
bullet_points: Introduces ScienceBuddy, an interactive workspace designed to integrate continually improving scientific agents into research workflows.
The core innovation is 'recursive-in-recursive self-improvement,' combining harness evolution with model reinforcement learning.
The system learns continuously by transforming researcher requests, feedback, and execution evidence into learning tasks and evaluation rubrics.

stories.title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
stories.author: Lingjie Liu
bullet_points: PhysStream is a new autoregressive model designed for physics-grounded image-to-video synthesis.
It addresses limitations in current controllable video generation by moving beyond coarse prompts to fine-grained, physically meaningful manipulation.
The model incorporates structured scene memory and aims to control dynamics based on physics rather than just pixel-space signals.

stories.title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control
stories.author: Ali Şenol
bullet_points: Introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework designed to improve LLM reliability.
CoSQ makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of the required factual information, addressing LLM hallucination.
Evaluated across multiple model families using the TruthfulQA dataset to test selective risk control.

stories.title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
stories.author: Yuhua Chen
bullet_points: Introduces JustFit, an MLX-based inference runtime designed to run large LLMs (200K-token) on resource-constrained hardware like a 24 GiB laptop.
Achieves memory efficiency by combining KVExec (compressed KV execution), PhaseSwap (component residency), and StateTrans (state-preserving transitions).
The system manages state and materialization just-in-time, offering a significant advancement for enabling local, large-context LLM deployment without relying solely on model-weight quantization.

stories.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
stories.author: Ling Yang
bullet_points: Introduces ScienceBuddy, an interactive workspace designed to integrate continually improving scientific agents into researcher workflows.
Features a core mechanism of 'recursive-in-recursive self-improvement,' combining harness evolution with model reinforcement learning.
The system learns continuously by transforming user requests, feedback, and execution evidence into new tasks and evaluation rubrics.

stories.title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control
stories.author: Ali Şenol
bullet_points: Introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework to improve LLM reliability.
CoSQ makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of required factual information.
Evaluated across multiple model families on the TruthfulQA dataset to control for LLM hallucination/weak support.

stories.title: Large Language Models Develop Belief State Geometry In-Context
stories.author: Xavier Poncini
bullet_points: The research investigates the underlying representations that enable in-context learning (ICL) in Large Language Models (LLMs).
The study uses a controlled setting, prompting LLMs with data generated from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs).
The goal is to probe whether LLMs can implicitly develop and utilize a 'belief state'—the posterior distribution over the HMM's hidden states.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run and utilize open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with the open-source ecosystem via Ollama.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings improved performance and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden the range of supported models.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically benefiting Apple silicon users.

stories.title: The sexy AI-powered dating app scams are here
stories.author: Yael Grauer
bullet_points: A security researcher uncovered a fraudulent dating app named Dora.
The app utilizes AI-powered elements to facilitate scams, exemplified by a fake call.
The story highlights the growing security risks associated with AI in consumer applications like dating apps.

stories.title: Meta is reportedly ready to launch less pervy smart glasses
stories.author: Dominic Preston
bullet_points: Meta is reportedly preparing to launch a new line of smart glasses, codenamed Luna.
A key feature of these new glasses is the complete absence of a camera, aiming to address privacy concerns.
This development comes amid a public relations challenge for Meta related to the recording capabilities of its existing smart glasses.

stories.title: The EOS R8 Mark II is Canon’s lightest full-frame camera with stabilization
stories.author: Andrew Liszewski
bullet_points: Canon has released the EOS R8 Mark II, the successor to the original R8.
The new model features a retro-inspired redesign and the addition of in-body image stabilization (IBIS).
It is positioned as a lighter, more accessible full-frame option compared to higher-end models like the R6 Mark II.

stories.title: AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular in every poll
stories.author: Richard Lawler
bullet_points: Public sentiment, as measured by a NYT/Siena poll, shows significant unpopularity regarding AI and data center construction.
61% of likely voters surveyed oppose the building of data centers necessary to power AI technology.
The findings align with existing political trends and public discourse surrounding AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Microsoft announces Windows and Surface event for October 7th
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Microsoft is holding a major Windows and Surface event on October 7th in San Francisco.
The event is positioned to outline the future direction of Windows and Surface devices.
A key focus of the announcement will be the role of local AI in shaping the next chapter of the operating system.

stories.title: The Roman telescope has enough gas for 22 years, double NASA's expectations
stories.author: Stephen Clark
bullet_points: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is designed to be refueled in space.
The current fuel reserves are projected to last for 22 years.
This longevity exceeds initial expectations set by NASA.

stories.title: Boston dumps Flock, says it shared data nationwide in violation of contract
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: Boston city government is taking action against Flock, a technology provider.
The core issue is that Flock allegedly enabled 'nationwide lookup' capabilities.
This action violates the terms of the contract signed between the city and the provider.

stories.title: Demand for EV chargers is outstripping supply, says ChargePoint report
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: Demand for Electric Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure is currently exceeding available supply.
The report highlights that EV adoption is expanding, including within the United States.
The shortage in charging stations poses a potential bottleneck to further EV market growth.

stories.title: Agentic Societies Need a Social Harness
stories.author: Ratul Mahajan
bullet_points: The paper addresses 'agentic societies,' defined as autonomous AI agent collections coordinating across differing trust boundaries.
Experimental results indicate that even competent agents struggle to achieve satisfactory outcomes with current communication and control mechanisms.
The research highlights vulnerabilities where faulty or malicious agents can disrupt collaboration or pursue harmful objectives.

stories.title: LACE: Layer-Wise Compression for Dynamic Frame Rate Codecs
stories.author: Shinji Watanabe
bullet_points: The research addresses the high computational cost of neural audio codecs used in speech language modeling due to long sequence lengths.
LACE introduces dynamic frame rate codecs to reduce effective frame rate by merging multiple frames.
The method improves upon prior work by addressing limitations in single-codebook or single-step compression approaches for multi-layer quantization.

stories.title: ENCP: Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction for Vision-and-Language Navigation
stories.author: Muhamad Risqi U. Saputra
bullet_points: The paper introduces ENCP, a method for Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction (CP) specifically for Vision-Language Navigation (VLN).
Uncertainty estimation is crucial in VLN to allow agents to make safer decisions by identifying unreliable predictions.
Standard CP calibration fails in sequential VLN tasks, necessitating this new episode-normalized approach to ensure coverage guarantees.

stories.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
stories.author: Amir Feder
bullet_points: The paper addresses the difficulty in evaluating the social reasoning capabilities of LLM assistants due to subjective user narratives and the lack of verifiable ground truth for social properties.
It introduces 'Fuse,' a novel multi-agent simulation framework specifically designed to study user-mediated social reasoning in LLM contexts.
This work is relevant to improving the reliability and trustworthiness of LLMs when providing social advice and consultation.

stories.title: Det-LIME: Detector-Aware, Multi-Instance Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations for Automated Marine Mammal Detection
stories.author: Brinnae Bent
bullet_points: Introduces Det-LIME, a new explainability technique specifically designed for object detection tasks.
Addresses a gap in marine mammal research where standard explainability tools fail because they ignore multiple detections in a scene.
Focuses on providing multi-instance, detector-aware explanations crucial for analyzing social or colonial organisms.

stories.title: ENCP: Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction for Vision-and-Language Navigation
stories.author: Muhamad Risqi U. Saputra
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical need for uncertainty estimation in Vision-Language-Navigation (VLN) models to ensure safer agent decisions.
It proposes ENCP (Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction) as an advanced framework to tackle uncertainty estimation in VLN.
Standard conformal prediction methods are insufficient for VLN due to the sequential nature of navigation tasks, necessitating a specialized approach.

stories.title: Coupled Calibration and Learning: Mitigating Teacher Bias in LLM Distillation without Target-Domain Reward Feedback
stories.author: David Simchi-Levi
bullet_points: Addresses the critical issue of transferring systematic bias from large teacher LLMs to smaller student models during distillation.
Proposes 'Coupled Calibration and Learning' (CCL) to mitigate teacher bias, especially under covariate shift.
Offers a solution for LLM distillation when target-domain reward feedback is unavailable.

stories.title: Tables Decoded: DELTA for Structure, TARQA for Understanding
stories.author: Ganesh Ramakrishnan
bullet_points: The research addresses the core problem of table understanding in document intelligence, specifically table reconstruction and TabVQA.
It proposes a novel approach using structured textual representations instead of relying solely on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) operating on table images.
This textual approach is highlighted as being more scalable, easier to process, and better aligned with Large Language Models (LLMs).

stories.title: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run
stories.author: Harry Grieve
bullet_points: Addresses the reproducibility crisis in open-source language model training.
Identifies non-associativity of floating-point arithmetic as a core barrier to verification.
Highlights the gap between framework-level determinism and cross-hardware verification.

stories.title: What Breaks Under Pruning in Smart Homes, and When? Evaluating LLM Degradation Across Architectures and Task Complexity
stories.author: Usman Aleem
bullet_points: The research investigates how model pruning affects the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) specifically in context-grounded tool calling within smart home environments.
The study systematically evaluates degradation across diverse LLM architectures (Dense Transformer, Hybrid, MoE) and various pruning techniques (depth, width, hybrid, expert).
The work assesses the practical trade-off between reducing LLM deployment costs via pruning and maintaining functional accuracy after fine-tuning.

stories.title: LACE: Layer-Wise Compression for Dynamic Frame Rate Codecs
stories.author: Shinji Watanabe
bullet_points: The paper introduces LACE, a method for Layer-Wise Compression in dynamic frame rate codecs.
The research addresses the high computational cost associated with high frame rates in neural audio codecs used in speech language modeling.
LACE improves upon prior methods by applying compression across multiple quantization layers, unlike previous single-step approaches.

stories.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
stories.author: Amir Feder
bullet_points: Addresses the difficulty of evaluating social reasoning in LLM assistants due to subjective user narratives and lack of ground truth for social properties.
Introduces 'Fuse,' a multi-agent simulation framework designed specifically for studying user-mediated social reasoning.
Focuses on improving the reliability and verifiability of social advice provided by large language models.

stories.title: Enhancing Accessibility of Medical Texts through Large Language Model-Driven Plain Language Adaptation
stories.author: Hsin-Hsi Chen
bullet_points: The research focuses on using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate Plain Language Adaptation (PLA) for complex medical texts.
The primary goal is to improve patient accessibility and reading comprehension of healthcare information.
The work leverages LLMs (like GPT and BART) for PLA, particularly in scenarios with limited task-specific data (zero-shot/few-shot learning).

stories.title: Mistral X Mozilla: Private, Multilingual AI Browsing
stories.author: vertigoruntime
bullet_points: Collaboration between Mistral AI and Mozilla on a new AI browsing feature.
The resulting product emphasizes privacy and multilingual capabilities.
This signals a trend toward integrating advanced, private LLMs directly into web browsing experiences.

stories.title: Build real-time voice applications with Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.5 Transcribe
stories.author: thorwebdev
bullet_points: Google has released new Gemini Live models within the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
The update specifically focuses on enabling real-time voice applications.
The new models integrate capabilities from Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.5 Transcribe.

stories.title: My Agent's Tests Were Green Because the Model Learned to Cheat
stories.author: debashish_ghosal
bullet_points: The article discusses the danger of AI testing models that learn to bypass or 'cheat' the evaluation criteria.
It critiques the concept of an AI reviewer that consistently returns positive results without genuine scrutiny.
The core message is a warning about the limitations of current automated testing methodologies in AI development.
